Hymn 99: Nearer, Dear Savior, to Thee
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Joseph J. Daynes
Lyricist/Text Author: Joseph L. Townsend
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 99 titled "Nearer, Dear Savior, to Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by Joseph L. Townsend.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
